title: Netcompany Ineos drops Continental for Pirelli in major WorldTour tyre switch | BikeRadar
summary: Netcompany Ineos drops Continental for Pirelli in major WorldTour tyre switch BikeRadar First tyre-brand change for the team since its founding as Team Sky in 2010 The Netcompany-Ineos pro cycling team has announced Pirelli will provide the team’s tyres, with its swap from Continental having already begun at the start of November in a three-year deal. Netcompany-Ineos’ announcement describes Pirelli as the team’s new “tyre and performance partner” and suggests the tyre maker will not only supply the team’s tyres from next season, but also co-develop new tyres with it, with the objective of producing “increasingly advanced road cycling tyres”. Netcompany-Ineos says its decision to change tyre providers from Continental was based on its technical evaluation of the P Zero Race SL-R tyre, which Pirelli launched in March this year and the team's continuing search for marginal gains in performance.

title: World’s top ten tyre makers diverge as European replacement demand cushions weaker OE - Tyrepress
summary: World’s top ten tyre makers diverge as European replacement demand cushions weaker OE Tyrepress The ten companies appearing at the top of the Tyrepress.com ‘World’s Leading Tyre Manufacturers’ table for 2026 have experienced mixed fortunes during the current financial year. Bridgestone and Yokohama Rubber posted record nine-month revenue and earnings, while Continental raised its profitability outlook on the strength of its European tyre business. During the same period, Goodyear’s segment operating income more than halved, and in the third quarter of 2026 Zhongce Rubber and Sailun sold more tyres but earned substantially less. In Europe, replacement demand offered opportunities even as original equipment (OE) volumes fell for several suppliers.

title: Continental SportContact 7 OE on Mercedes-AMG CLA - Tyrepress
summary: Continental SportContact 7 OE on Mercedes-AMG CLA Tyrepress Mercedes-Benz’s high-performance division has approved tailor-made versions of the Continental SportContact 7 for the latest generation Mercedes-AMG CLA. This approval covers six 19- and 20-inch tyre sizes. All approved sizes bear Mercedes-AMG’s vehicle-specific MO1 or MO1A original-equipment marking.
